fact: The Namibia Revenue Agency's ITAS e-portal lets taxpayers log in to submit returns online, object to assessments, get account statements and print registration certificates; the page gives no event date, so as_of is its 2025 published year.
The Harambee Prosperity Plan II activity page lists the integrated Tax Administration System (ITAS) among existing databases to be linked by data-integration MoUs, planned 22 Sep to 31 Oct 2021.
The Harambee Prosperity Plan II activity page lists the integrated Financial Management System (IFMS) among existing databases to be linked by data-integration MoUs, planned 22 Sep to 31 Oct 2021.

NamRA says its Integrated Tax Administration System (ITAS) is in use for taxpayers' returns, with key functions restored but intermittent slowness remaining, and it extended the filing deadline from 30 June to 31 August 2026.
NamRA's Commissioner referred to the Integrated Tax Administration System and the Customs System as NamRA's existing systems that are to be fully integrated.
